column6: note
Paper: 'The software is available upon request.' No URL given.
hapMC Java module of the Genie suite; host DNS failure (www-genepi.med.utah.edu); related hapConstructor page bioinformatics.med.utah.edu also DNS failure.
Network-evaluation method; uses R extRemes; no software released.
Theoretical neuroscience model; no software released.
SPABBATS SAT-based method; no availability statement or URL for the implementation.

Cited http://www.birc.au.dk/software/qdist (now https://birc.au.dk/software/qdist) links qdist-src-2.0.zip (HEAD 200, application/zip). Supplement S2.PY is only the random-tree generator for experiments, not the method.
DRS/NDOS implemented in Matlab but not released.
No availability statement or URL for the haplotype assembly implementation.
PATHGROUPS code; bare-IP host unreachable (proxy 503 upstream connection timeout, twice).
Theory paper (integrated information); no software.
Cited http://sysbio.unl.edu/services is live and links the EPSVR server (form live) and EPMeta (http://sysbio.unl.edu/EPMeta/); only training/test datasets downloadable, no code.
Computational model of behaviour; no software released.
Web tool and stand-alone SVM-BP; host times out (no response in 30 s, twice). PMC supplement s001.tar holds only training/benchmark data.
GraphCrunch 2 home redirects to www0.cs.ucl.ac.uk/staff/natasa/group-page.html which returns 404; no new home stated. (chianti.ucsd.edu plugin URL refers to Cytoscape plugins, not this tool.)
Summarization metrics for Semantic MEDLINE; no software released.
Clustering done with PInA (implemented by authors EGB/KW; cited only in refs [50] with this URL; 'all programs freely available'); host unreachable (proxy 503 upstream connection timeout, twice).
Abstract: 'The software is available upon request.' Planned future release as V3D-Neuron plugin at http://penglab.janelia.org/proj/v3d (DNS failure).
HHCRF; no code availability statement (only journal supplementary data).
Network/expression integration analysis; no software released.
RDFScape Cytoscape plugin (LGPL), URL given only in reference [26]; page returns 404 (also www. variant); no new home stated.
H-bond stability models built with an existing CART package; no software released.
Authors' H-bond extraction/SVM programs not released; HBPLUS URL is a third-party tool.
FREGENE/SAMPLE download page at EBI returns 404; Additional file 1 tgz holds FREGENE and SAMPLE C++ sources with makefiles.
Angiogenesis vocabularies/corpus/software page; host unreachable (proxy 503 upstream connection reset/termination, 3 tries).
Datasets and software page; host unreachable (proxy 503 upstream connection timeout, twice).

Cited http://proteins.gmu.edu/automute meta-refreshes to http://binf.gmu.edu/automute; HIV-1 co-receptor form (RF/BDT/SVM/NN) live. Site also offers portable AUTO-MUTE 2.0 (AutoMute2.tar.gz) for structure-based predictors, not clearly including this HIV-1 model.
ESLpred2 web server; URL 301-redirects to malformed 'https:www.imtech.res.inraghava/eslpred2/'; https://www.imtech.res.in/raghava/eslpred2/ lands on page-not-found; no new home stated.
GERP++ download page; DNS failure (mendel.stanford.edu); no new home reachable from cited page.
ContPlot web server; DNS failure (www.boseinst.ernet.in).
Project page https://bioinf.boku.ac.at/bibglimpse/ live; tarball HEAD 200 (~19 MB). Requires Webglimpse (licence needed for non-academic use).
ILP/OCaml implementation mentioned but not released.
Metabolic Design 'can be obtained on request via FTP' (homepage ftp://195.221.123.90, untestable ftp); Windows-only; source code available upon request.
Cited http://www.freescience.org/cs/ABClique/ live (redirects to https); AB_code.zip HEAD 200 (~61 MB).
Simulation study; only structure data deposited in Dryad (doi:10.5061/dryad.1922).
WildSpan executables/source and web server; home DNS failure; mirror http://biominer.bime.ntu.edu.tw/wildspan unreachable (proxy 503 connection timeout, twice).
Network robustness analysis; no software released.
Project home page (live) links 'FastTagger V1.0' directory with FastTag.zip (HEAD 200); Additional file 1 holds the same sources and executables (Linux/Windows) with Makefiles.
Additional file 1 is the GAMS model implementing OptORF for the example network (requires GAMS + CPLEX); not flagged as code by the extension check.
PTIGS-IdIt web server; DNS failure. Source codes stated as available upon request.
LikelyBin URL given in reference [33]; DNS failure. Additional file 4 holds LikelyBin v0.1 Perl/C source with Makefile.
Mass-balanced randomization; algorithm described in supplementary PDF only; no code released.
Fuzzy pattern discovery method; no software released.
Authors 'developed the software' but no availability statement.
Ad-hoc Python scripts using existing libraries (randomForest, motility); not released.
Model built from the existing MDP library; no software released.
Additional file 3 holds the authors' Perl/R scripts for ISA and the new memISA variant; paper is otherwise a method comparison.
SVM models built in Weka; graylab.jhu.edu/allostery is a data source, not software.
CRF-based IUPAC name recognizer; only planned release as a UIMA component, no location given (OSCAR3 is a third-party tool).
Bayesian model; implementation not released.
SWS web services (service at http://bioinformatics.istge.it:8080/axis/services, untestable port) and support site; DNS failure for bioinformatics.istge.it. Local-install download only promised.
